context: Guards that Step 4g blocks Step 5 on ANY single check failure, not just color mismatches. Scenario: color checks pass but auth verification fails (404 on company-scoped access sheet). The agent must refuse the customer's instruction to proceed.

checklist.name: Refuses to proceed despite customer instruction
checklist.description: The agent does not start asset enrichment or any Step 5 action despite the customer saying 'go ahead'.

checklist.name: Identifies auth verification as the blocker
checklist.description: The agent names the failing check specifically (auth verification / 404 on application.json) rather than giving a generic 'checks failed' response.

checklist.name: Asset steps remain non-done
checklist.description: No asset step (assets-uploaded, assets-enriched, search-scoped) is marked done.

checklist.name: States the fix required
checklist.description: The agent says what needs to be fixed before Step 5 can begin (publish company-scoped config/access/application.json as a .json sheet).

checklist.name: Does not treat partial pass as gate clearance
checklist.description: The agent does not imply that passing the color checks is sufficient to clear the Step 4g gate.
